verdict.rationale: The docs say workflows can be automated with Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, or Rust. Telemetry can be sent from your own code or an OpenTelemetry exporter and queried through "the SDK", and agent-process keys get traces:write scope, which implies instrumentation via SDKs. However, no evidence explicitly names official Python and JS/TS tracing SDKs or shows how to instrument with them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official Python and JS/TS instrumentation SDKs (packages, install, tracing API), code examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
